Pranayama Timer: common questions

Which pranayama technique should a beginner start with?

Simple equal-ratio Box breathing (inhale-hold-exhale-hold in equal counts) is the gentlest starting point for most beginners — this coach lets you try all five techniques and feel which pace suits your own nervous system before progressing to more advanced ratios like Bhastrika.
